construct.name: equities franchise value growth alongside winning via cap efficiency, profitability, foresight surplus
construct.plain_English: equities franchise value growth alongside winning via cap efficiency, profitability, foresight surplus
construct.definition: We measure whether a franchise builds long-term enterprise value by converting cheap capital (cap efficiency), sustainable profitability (stay-on-floor cash conversion), and foresight surplus (draft/trade foresight analogue: early stake in winners vs later cost) into wins that compound valuation. Not vanity points or single-year EBITDA.
construct.adapted_from_hoops: Hoops Front Office Lab: draft pick quality, salary-cap/contract efficiency vs wins, foresight on appreciating deals. Equities analogue: cap efficiency = fwd_pred / cap_norm (payroll projection 2025-26 deterministic 5-1505B), profitability = margin + cash conversion, foresight surplus = early stake vs late chase
